items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: oh what’s this girl’s name — Sarah McLaughlin. I like her very much.

ctx.x: Do your kids listen to your music?

They do now. They’re all adult. My youngest daughter will be 18 in March. So they’re young adults. And they’ve really come to enjoy music and they like jazz, which I’m amazed, and they have tastes of things that they like. None of them are listening to heavy metal thank goodness. But they’re listening to — and they’ve turned me on to some people — oh what’s this girl’s name — Sarah McLaughlin. I like her very much. Some people — I like a lot of r & b and some good pop and I’m not a jazz snob, I mean I have stuff…
When they brought their friends home from junior high school, I mean you didn’t sit them down and say, here’s my latest album.
